text:
emma_support: FYI ACME reporting a noticeable drop in answer quality after we enabled the 'draft_sampling' speculative path on the canary this morning. They sent side-by-side examples. cc @raj_engineer @olivia_prod

acme_csm: Example prompt + responses below. We used model=redwood-draft-v1, rollout started ~2026-02-18T14:20Z.

acme_csm: PROMPT: "Summarize the employee reimbursement policy for travel expenses."
GOOD (pre-rollout): "Employees are reimbursed for approved travel expenses with receipts. Submit expense reports within 30 days; meals capped at $50/day; pre-approval required for international travel."
BAD (post-rollout): "Travel reimbursements depend on manager's notes. Submit forms. Some items might be covered. Contact HR."

acme_csm: Request body (we're sending):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-draft-v1",
  "input": "Summarize the employee reimbursement policy for travel expenses.",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 160,
  "draft_sampling": true,
  "speculative_beams": 2
}
```

emma_support: Customer sees higher hallucinations and less precise facts. They flagged on production traffic not just canary.

raj_engineer: Looking into logs now. Can you paste the request-id from one of the failing calls? Also want the full prompt + context (if any).

acme_csm: request_id=rid-20260218-48af, convo_id=acme-2309. No extra context. They ran at 14:33:12Z.

raj_engineer: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: speculative/draft path can underweight confidence checks when temp=0 with beams; maybe the merge heuristic prioritized short draft candidates. Will reproduce locally.

olivia_prod: If this is affecting customer SLOs we should flip the feature flag for the canary or target their org ASAP. Can we disable draft_sampling per-tenant? @raj_engineer

raj_engineer: We have a per-tenant feature flag: enable_speculative_draft. I can toggle it for acme_corp. Doing a scoped disable first.

liam_oncall: Before toggle, can we run a quick A/B evaluation: run 50 sample prompts with draft_sampling true vs false and compute exact-match/factuality heuristics? I can spin up the eval harness.

monitoring-bot: alert: quality-regression-acme_corp triggered. metric: factuality_score dropped from 0.92 -> 0.68 over last 2 hours.

raj_engineer: I'm toggling flag now for org=acme_corp -> enable_speculative_draft=false. Command: 
```
/ff toggle --org=acme_corp --flag=enable_speculative_draft --value=false --env=prod-canary
```

raj_engineer: Done. Please verify with ACME.

acme_csm: Confirmed — their sample set looks like the old quality level immediately after the toggle. They're running a broader smoke check and will report in 10m. :relieved:

olivia_prod: Good. Next steps: block full rollout of speculative draft until eng provides root cause and a fix or improved merge heuristics. Also add regression tests to the eval harness covering factuality for policy questions.

raj_engineer: Agreed. I'm running diffs on the speculative merge codepath. Early quick find: when speculative_beams>1 and temperature=0, we sometimes select shorter high-prob prefixes from draft candidates that omit required constraints (e.g., explicit limits). I'll open a PR to tighten the re-ranking to prefer factual spans.

liam_oncall: I'll run the 50-sample A/B now and post metrics. If the PR can't land quickly we should add a safety-gate in routing: fallback to non-draft path when factuality metrics are below threshold for a tenant.

emma_support: Thanks team — ACME is elevated but appreciates quick scoped disable. They asked for ETA on permanent fix and whether this could affect other customers under the canary.

raj_engineer: ETA depends on fix complexity; initial patch for re-ranking + new tests ~48 hours. I'll post a link to the PR and changelog once ready. Will also add a temporary global guard (opt-out of speculative path when model type==policy-summary).

acme_csm: Please keep me posted. Customer wants an incident summary and what exactly changed in rollout (flags, model build).

olivia_prod: Emma, can you assemble a short incident note for ACME: what we changed, confirmation of rollback, next steps, and timeline? We'll attach the PR link when available.

emma_support: On it. I'll draft and share in this thread.

monitoring-bot: note: watchlist added for acme_corp quality; automatic rollback threshold set to 0.75 factuality_score for production canary.

raj_engineer: Adding unit/regression tests to prevent this class of drift. Will follow up with postmortem once PR is merged.

acme_csm: Thanks all, customer is happy with scoped disable and expects updates.

olivia_prod: Great, closing loop after PR + verification. :thumbsup:
